#### Veeam

**Agent Management**

This dashboard gives visibility into agent management in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total and failed agent events, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces protection groups and source IPs. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer an agent-operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
